name: Burgundy

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

keyfacts: Burgundy classifications follow geography, not producers, with four levels from regional and village to Premier Cru and Grand Cru.
Delineating vineyards by terroir goes back to medieval times, and the climats of Burgundy are on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
The most famous wines are dry reds from Pinot Noir and whites from Chardonnay, with Gamay and Aligoté also grown.

blurb.text: A region in east-central France whose best-known wines are dry reds from Pinot Noir and whites from Chardonnay.
